prompts.prompt:
Create a new production sprite sheet: one COMPLETE EIGHT-FRAME WALK CYCLE for the exact seaside shopper in the supplied identity reference. The reference is for identity, clothing, proportions and style ONLY, not a pose sequence.
Layout: exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight equally sized cells, reading left to right then next row. Genuine transparent background. No labels, numbering, grid lines, shadows, scenery, food, or additional people. Every cell contains the same COMPLETE full-body right-facing shopper, hair to sandal soles. Keep the same body scale, hip centre, camera angle, facial features, clothes, and a common ground baseline relative to each cell. Do not let heads, hair or feet touch cell borders. Preserve transparent gutters. The contact poses should be about 80 source-pixels high when later reduced into 128x128 game cells.
Identity and rendering: cheerful young adult man, medium warm skin, curly dark brown hair, small beard, open mustard-yellow short sleeve shirt over white T-shirt, navy shorts, brown strap sandals. Match the crisp outlined retro game sprite of the identity reference, retaining detail and colour clusters readable when displayed only 40 game pixels tall. Three-quarter SIDE view, body travelling RIGHT, both legs visible. Consistent dark navy outlines, softly limited flat shading; no glossy painting.
The KEY requirement is a biomechanically legible ALTERNATING WALK, not eight near-identical standing poses and not two repeats of the same half-step. Near leg means the leg closer to camera; far leg is the darker leg behind it. Near and far legs must genuinely swap which leads halfway through the cycle. Clear bent knees, lifted swing foot, heel-first contacts and toe-off. The free back arm swings opposite the near leg. The forward food-carrying hand stays loosely palm-up at waist height, EMPTY, in a fairly stable position for a separate food overlay. Small natural body down/up motion is welcome, do not stretch the figure.
Exact poses, in sequence:
1 TOP LEFT — NEAR LEG CONTACT: near leg extended forward toward the right, heel contacting ground; far leg stretched behind toward the left, toe still at ground. Wide readable stride.
2 — DOWN: near foot is planted forward and knee bends under body weight; far heel lifts behind, starting to swing.
3 — PASSING: near support leg nearly vertical; far knee bends and passes FORWARD underneath the hip, far foot clearly lifted off the ground.
4 — UP: near support leg trails behind on toe; far knee and foot have swung forward, far foot still raised before its next heel contact.
5 BOTTOM LEFT — FAR LEG CONTACT: FAR leg now stretched forward toward the right with its heel on ground; NEAR leg extended back toward the left on its toe. This MUST be the OPPOSITE lead leg from pose 1, retaining consistent leg depth and anatomy, not a duplicate pose 1.
6 — DOWN: far foot planted forward and knee bends under weight; near heel lifts behind, starting its forward swing.
7 — PASSING: far support leg nearly vertical; NEAR knee bends and passes forward under the hip, near sandal visibly raised.
8 — UP: far support leg trails behind on toe; near knee and foot swing forward toward the next near-leg contact in pose 1.
Keep near/far leg identity readable through shorts edges and slightly darker far-leg shading. All eight drawings form ONE smooth full cycle. Every change of leg anatomy must be drawn in the generated artwork; we will only crop, align and play the real frames.

Edit ONLY the lower-body leg anatomy in the BOTTOM ROW of this 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet. Preserve the complete TOP ROW pixel-for-pixel. Preserve all eight character identities, hair, faces, shirts, food-carrying hands, upper bodies, figure scale, grid positions and genuine transparent background. No text or added objects.

The error to correct: the bottom row currently repeats the same leading leg as the top row. It must instead show the OPPOSITE half of a full walk cycle. Near leg = the lighter warm skin leg closest to camera. Far leg = the slightly darker skin leg behind it. Near leg and far leg must keep these identities and depth, but exchange forward/backward positions. Keep the same mustard-shirt shopper, navy shorts and brown strap sandals.

BOTTOM LEFT / frame 5: put the LIGHTER NEAR LEG clearly extending BACKWARDS to the LEFT from its shorts opening, with its heel raised and only its toe at the ground. The DARKER FAR LEG extends FORWARDS to the RIGHT behind it, with its heel contacting ground. The dark forward leg must visibly emerge from behind the shorts and near thigh; no detached extra leg. This is the exact opposing-leg contact to top-left.
BOTTOM frame 6: DARKER FAR LEG is the planted supporting leg forward on the RIGHT, knee bending under weight. LIGHTER NEAR LEG is behind on the LEFT with its heel lifting and its knee starting to bend forward.
BOTTOM frame 7: DARKER FAR LEG is almost vertical, supporting the body. LIGHTER NEAR LEG bends and lifts its knee in front of the body, its raised near sandal passes to the RIGHT of the dark supporting shin.
BOTTOM frame 8: DARKER FAR LEG trails to the LEFT on toe, LIGHTER NEAR LEG swings forward to the RIGHT, its sandal raised just before next heel contact. This leads back naturally to the unchanged first frame.
Only TWO legs per figure, correct hips/knees/ankles. Preserve the full head-to-sandals figures and the 4x2 cell layout. Do not simply tint the current legs or repeat top-row poses; redraw the bottom-row anatomy to establish opposite supporting legs.

Generate a professional 8-frame SIDE-VIEW walking animation sprite sheet of this SAME yellow-shirt shopper, in 4 columns x 2 rows on a transparent canvas. Identity reference only: same curly brown hair, beard, mustard open shirt, white T-shirt, navy shorts and brown sandals, same crisp retro game sprite finish. Full body in every cell. All characters face RIGHT. Same size and same hip centre in every equal cell. Each complete character should reduce cleanly to 40 game pixels tall. No food, labels, ground, shadows, or grid.

Use the STANDARD EIGHT-POSE WALK CYCLE, with two genuinely opposite contacts, not repeated half-cycles. Draw the legs in a clear side profile, with the nearest leg unobscured and the farther leg darker. The near leg must start stretched FORWARD and be stretched BACKWARD in frame 5. Physically redraw the shorts openings/knees/calves accordingly.

FRAME 1: LEFT foot forward heel contact, RIGHT foot behind on toe.
FRAME 2: LEFT foot planted, left knee bent; RIGHT foot lifts behind.
FRAME 3: LEFT leg vertical, supporting the body. RIGHT bent leg passes forward with its foot lifted under hip.
FRAME 4: LEFT leg behind on toe, RIGHT leg swung forward with foot lifted.
FRAME 5: RIGHT foot forward heel contact, LEFT foot behind on toe. OPPOSITE legs to frame 1. The nearest light-skinned leg is visibly behind, far darker leg is forward.
FRAME 6: RIGHT foot planted, right knee bent; LEFT foot lifts behind.
FRAME 7: RIGHT leg vertical supporting body. LEFT bent leg passes forward with its foot lifted under hip.
FRAME 8: RIGHT leg behind on toe, LEFT leg swung forward with foot lifted, ready to contact as frame 1.

Keep his empty forward palm at waist height for a separate food sprite; free arm counter-swings naturally. Clear knee flexion and large readable foot lift. Preserve natural up/down motion of the hips, stable head size and consistent limb lengths. No skating, standing duplicates, extra legs, or repeated lead-leg contact. The full walk cycle is the deliverable.

Edit this single sprite's walking pose, changing ONLY the shorts/legs/sandals. Keep his head, hair, face, yellow shirt, arms, empty hand, overall size, right-facing direction and genuine transparent background unchanged.
He must now walk with the OPPOSITE LEG forward. The light leg attached to the FRONT/RIGHT shorts opening must extend diagonally DOWN AND BACK TO THE LEFT, its toe touching the ground behind him and heel raised. The darker leg attached to the REAR/LEFT shorts opening must extend diagonally DOWN AND FORWARD TO THE RIGHT, its heel on ground in front of him.
The legs CROSS at their origins below the shorts. The LIGHT NEAR THIGH passes visibly in FRONT of the DARK FAR THIGH. At the lower calves, the light leg is BEHIND the body on the LEFT of the image, the dark leg is IN FRONT of the body on the RIGHT of the image. This is an opposing walking contact. Do NOT keep the light calf and foot in their current forward/right position.
Only two anatomically correct complete legs. Same sandals, shorts, leg lengths and sprite finish. Full hair-to-soles figure.

Edit this 4x2 walk sprite sheet to correct LEG DEPTH SHADING ONLY. Preserve the exact character poses, anatomy, scale, grid layout, clothing, faces, hair, arms, hands, sandals, outlines and transparency. Do not draw new poses. Use the second supplied single figure ONLY as a leg-colour reference: its BACK/LEFT leg is warm bright skin and its FRONT/RIGHT leg is a deeper brown skin tone, showing the opposite leading leg.

Skin-colour correction by cell, reading left to right, top row then bottom row:
Cell 1: keep original light forward/right leg and dark back/left leg.
Cell 2: keep original light forward/right supporting leg and dark bent back/left leg.
Cell 3: make the RAISED bent leg/knee/sandal on the RIGHT dark brown, and the VERTICAL supporting leg on the LEFT warm bright skin.
Cell 4: make the FORWARD lifted leg on the RIGHT dark brown, and the trailing supporting leg on the LEFT warm bright skin.
Cell 5: make the FORWARD extended leg on the RIGHT dark brown, and the BACK extended leg on the LEFT warm bright skin, matching the second reference.
Cell 6: make the FORWARD/VERTICAL supporting leg on the RIGHT dark brown, and the BENT BACK leg on the LEFT warm bright skin.
Cell 7: keep the raised leg on the RIGHT warm bright skin and supporting leg on the LEFT darker brown.
Cell 8: keep the forward lifted leg on the RIGHT warm bright skin and trailing leg on the LEFT darker brown.

Keep the bright leg consistent with his arm skin; the far leg is a darker brown version of the same skin, not black and not a different ethnicity. This makes the two contact poses visibly use opposite lead legs, with the passing leg changing correctly between half-cycles. Do not recolour his face, hands, shorts or sandals. All body/pose artwork is retained. Genuine transparent background.

Create FOUR sequential full-body sprite drawings of the exact shopper in this reference, facing RIGHT, laid out in one horizontal row on a genuine transparent background. Same mustard shirt, white T-shirt, navy shorts, sandals, curly hair, beard, body size and crisp retro-game finish. Empty forward palm at waist height. No text, ground, shadows, borders or other people.
This is ONE HALF STEP with a single supporting leg throughout: the NEAR/LIGHT leg supports his weight and moves from forward to behind as the torso passes over that planted foot. The other DARK/FAR leg swings from behind to ahead. Do not alternate supporting legs within these four drawings.
Pose 1: NEAR leg straight FORWARD/right, heel on ground; FAR leg straight BACK/left on toe.
Pose 2: NEAR supporting leg in front, knee softly bent, full sandal on ground. FAR heel lifts behind with knee bending.
Pose 3: NEAR supporting leg straight DOWN under his body, sandal on ground. The FAR leg bends its knee and swings forward; FAR sandal is raised 8 game pixels above the ground and crosses IN FRONT of the supporting shin. The raised knee and foot belong to the DARK/FAR leg.
Pose 4: NEAR supporting leg extends BACKWARDS to the left, only its toe on ground. FAR leg extends FORWARDS to the right with its raised heel about to land. The FORWARD calf is DARK; the trailing calf is LIGHT.
Same camera and hips aligned to the same location inside every cell, same leg lengths, clear natural body weight. Full figures, feet and hair entirely inside cells.

Pose 1: FAR leg straight FORWARD/right, heel on ground; NEAR leg straight BACK/left on toe. Match the supplied reference's light back leg and darker front leg.
Pose 2: FAR supporting leg in front, knee softly bent, full sandal on ground. NEAR heel lifts behind with knee bending.

Create a technical 2D CUTOUT ANIMATION PARTS sheet for the exact male shopper in the supplied identity reference. Genuine transparent background. The parts themselves must be fully illustrated in the same crisp retro game art, dark navy outlines, warm skin, navy shorts and brown strap sandals. These are isolated illustrated limb pieces for a game puppet, NOT walking poses. No text, labels, outlines of cells, people, hands, torsos, heads, scenery, backgrounds, shadows or extra parts.
Layout exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX equally spaced cells on a wide canvas.
Top row = near leg parts with brighter skin:
TOP LEFT: one BARE UPPER LEG / THIGH, from rounded hip joint at top to rounded knee at bottom. A small navy shorts cuff overlaps the top; a warm skin thigh below. Straight vertical, slightly tapered, front-side view. Joint ends rounded and fully painted to overlap with other pieces.
TOP MIDDLE: one BARE LOWER LEG / CALF, rounded knee at top to rounded ankle at bottom. Straight vertical, slight calf volume. Same skin and outline. No foot attached.
TOP RIGHT: one complete BROWN STRAP SANDAL FOOT with toes visible, side profile pointing RIGHT, heel to LEFT. The ankle opening is above the heel/left half. Long foot horizontal and flat; sole beneath.
Bottom row = far leg parts, identical proportions and shapes but with darker/shadowed warm skin and darker sandal:
BOTTOM LEFT: upper thigh matching top-left.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: lower calf matching top-middle.
BOTTOM RIGHT: sandal foot matching top-right, pointing RIGHT.
Every piece is separate, fully inside its equal cell with ample transparent padding. Make the thigh and calf similar lengths; thigh somewhat wider than calf, sandals about 70 percent of the shin length. Maintain clean readable anatomy and crisp chunky colour clusters, suitable for a complete 40-pixel tall character. NO grids, letters, numbers, toes detached, complete characters or extra body parts.

Edit ONLY the rendering finish and skin colour of the SIX isolated leg parts in image 1. Keep the same 3-column by 2-row arrangement, every limb shape and every pivot/joint shape unchanged, genuine transparent background. Image 2 is the exact CHARACTER STYLE AND SKIN COLOUR reference.
Match the arms and legs of image 2: warm mid-orange/brown skin, crisp dark NAVY outlines, only ONE darker shadow colour, NO pale yellow/white highlight spots. The current bright white/yellow joint circles and calf highlights make the limbs look fragmented when reduced. Remove those light patches, making each thigh and calf a continuous opaque warm-skin shape with one simple side shadow. Round joint ends are fully painted skin, no holes or light rings.
The upper thigh navy shorts cuffs must match image 2's navy shorts. Brown strap sandals with flat navy/brown soles, warm toes, no cream highlights. Bottom-row far leg is modestly darker than the top row. Preserve all six pieces, proportions, complete foot silhouettes and the transparent gutters. No extra objects or labels.
